howToPlaySub: Read the instructions below before starting your assessment.
step1Body: Each question presents a waste item in a clinical context. Identify which of the four bins it belongs in.
step2BodyTouch: Press and hold the item card, then drag it onto the correct colored bin below. Release to drop.
step2BodyDesktop: Drag the item card into the correct bin, or simply click the bin directly.
step3Body: You have 20 seconds per question. Answering faster earns more bonus points on top of the base 100.
